renewable_surplus_handling.rule: For full TRAIN only, add an explicit non-economic surplus_export_mw sink to raw residual load. Its bus allocation first removes negative bus residuals, then covers any shortfall to the frozen 30 MW aggregate generator Pmin according to base-load-share weights. Wind, BTM solar, and gross load remain unchanged; export is not an OPF or strategic action variable.

stop_rule: TRAIN-only materialization for 8760 hours; DEV, HOLDOUT, Action-Space-v2, SFT, and GRPO are untouched.
